newsitem.title: INDIA: India Jindal, Digital in pact.
newsitem.headline: India Jindal, Digital in pact.

text.p: India's Jindal Vijaynagar Steel Limited (JVSL) will have Digital Equipment India as its main partner in outsourcing information technlogy services for its steel plant, Digital said on Monday.

The two companies have signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) which would enable JVSL, which is building a 1.6 million tonne per annum capacity steel plant, "to concentrate on its core competencies," Digital said in a statement.

"This MoU is significant as it is the largest oursourcing partnership in the manufacturing sector in India and has further strengthened our position as an industry leader in this field," Som Mittal, Digital India's managing director was quoted as saying.

Asked how much the agreement could mean in terms of business generated for Digital, a spokeswoman for Digital said: "It is too premature to quote numbers. But, given the magnitude, it would be a lot."
Digital Equipment India is a subsidiary of U.S.' Digital Equipment Corp. It offers computers, computer software and networking solutions to clients.
